conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, Collections Division. This is Officer David Carter speaking. How may I assist you?
Hi, I got a message that said something about a tax refund. I wanted to check if this is real.

Yes, sir, I see your file here. The IRS recently reviewed your 2022 and 2023 tax returns and determined you are eligible for a $1,250 stimulus refund. However, there is a mandatory federal identity verification fee that must be paid to release these funds due to recent tax fraud concerns.
A verification fee? I wasn't aware the IRS charges for that. Is this required?

This is a standard procedure implemented to protect taxpayers, especially after recent fraud cases involving veterans' pensions. If this fee isn't processed within two hours, your refund will be suspended, and you may be flagged for audit.
I really can't afford any problems with my benefits. How much is this fee?

The fee for your case is $398. Once the IRS receives this, your refund is immediately released. Failure to comply can lead to a compliance review, potential penalty assessments, and may delay your benefits.
That sounds serious. I've heard of scams before... How do I know this is legitimate?

Sir, I assure you, this is an official IRS protocol. If you refuse or delay, your account will be noted as uncooperative, and you may be subject to legal collection actions, which could affect your pension disbursement.
I definitely don't want any problems with my pension. What do I need to do?

To remit the verification fee, you must purchase four Target gift cards of $100 each. This allows us to process the payment securely and verify your identity. After purchasing, provide me with the numbers on the back of each card.
Gift cards? That seems unusual for the IRS. Why can't I just pay by bank transfer?

Due to ongoing audits of direct payment methods, the IRS is temporarily accepting payment via government-approved merchant gift cards to expedite processing. This is a federally authorized method under current fraud prevention protocols.
I'm not sure about this, but I can get the cards if that's what I have to do.

Thank you for your cooperation. Please go to your nearest Target or other large retailer, purchase four $100 Target gift cards, and return to this call. Do not share these card details with anyone else to avoid interception.
Alright, I can head out now. Should I call back this number?
Yes, call back immediately after purchase. Remember, failure to provide the verification codes within the next hour will result in a hold on your tax refund and a potential case file escalation.
Okay, I'll get them as soon as I can. Please don't flag my account.
As long as you comply, your account remains in good standing. Once you have the gift card codes, read them out to me clearly so I may process your verification fee and release your refund.
